rules.replacement: LogInfoEvent(BCLog::ALL, "block_template_created", "CreateNewBlock(): total size: {bytes} txs: {count} fees: {amount_sats} sigChecks {sig_checks}").Field(BCLog::LogField::Bytes, nSerializeSize).Field(BCLog::LogField::Count, blockFitter.nBlockTx).Field(BCLog::LogField::AmountSats, blockFitter.nFees / SATOSHI).Field(BCLog::LogField::SigChecks, blockFitter.nBlockSigChecks)

reviewed_input.format: CreateNewBlock(): total size: %u txs: %u fees: %ld sigChecks %d

rules.review_note: Preserve Info, exact human summary, unsigned serialized-byte/transaction/sigcheck counters and signed integer base-unit fees. Amount ostream emits its stored int64 units, so /SATOSHI exposes exactly the old number without coin conversion. Preserve all blockfitter/reserved-resource/coinbase/merklix decisions and evaluation order. Signature-check count is uint64 despite old %d; never narrow.

support_adjustments.purpose: Append unsigned signature-check count, matching BlockFitter uint64_t rather than legacy format spelling.
support_adjustments.new:
X(ClientVersion, client_version, STRING, "", "") \
    X(SigChecks, sig_checks, UINT, "", "")
